audit_notes: All material claims in the implementation section are traceable to named Tier 2B or Tier 3 source artifacts. One significant source inconsistency was identified: milestones_seed.json MS3 verifiable criterion uses legacy 'profit-based recommendation logic / expected economic return' language that has not been updated to reflect the operator-confirmed RQ6=WUE decision. The section correctly renders MS3 as 'WUE-based recommendation operational', consistent with the higher-authority confirmation_checklist.json (RQ6) and workpackage_seed.json (WP2 objectives). This inconsistency between Tier 3 artifacts should be logged per CLAUDE.md §12.3. Claim C17 is therefore inferred rather than confirmed. All risk claims (C22) are inferred per risks.json validation_status='Inferred'/evidence_strength='synthesis' — appropriate. No fabricated project facts detected. All partner names, expertise claims, and project decisions trace to confirmation_checklist.json or project_summary.json.
